      "snippet": "Yeah, your little 🐜 termite is just very chatty 😂
Why it keeps saying “Copied:” over and over
In the script we gave it, there’s this bit:
bashCopy codecp "$FILE" "$EXPORT_DIR/$BASENAME"
echo "Copied: $BASENAME"
COUNT=$((COUNT+1))

So for every file that survives:

It copies that file into
/sdcard/Download/KnowledgeCorpus_Export/

Then prints:
Copied: <that filename>

Increments the total count

That’s why you see:

Copied: KnowledgeCorpus_ALL_v16.3_MERGED_FULL.json

Copied: MetaBlooms_KnowledgeC"
